independent_review.text:
# Independent review: main RxJS 6 floor capsule

The frozen capsule supports the stated single main-line floor observation, with the limits below. Qualification SHA256 `b64aaf3503880cb678bafe3ab91cd195aa4eed71829758221102668d4044b442`; this does not qualify the full release matrix. I checked the exact retained reports and inputs rather than rerunning the expensive lanes.

The official `https://nodejs.org/dist/v24.15.0/SHASUMS256.txt` gives `f3d5a797b5d210ce8e2cb265544c8e482eaedcb8aa409a8b46da7e8595d0dda0` for the linux-arm64 archive; the checked-in consumer floor plan specifies the same URL and hash. The retained archive matches it, and its actual node binary member matches extracted executable SHA256 `d0b9f94a9771bba3c30a54f0aee622fa0bee37be684cc1df6da2d3448606d98d`. Both floor consumer and historical fixture locks contain exactly one RxJS package, 6.5.3. The consumer reports Node 24.15.0 arm64, Angular/CDK/Material 22.1.7, TypeScript 6.0.2; the historical fixture's actual installed package versions agree. This is the specified one floor combination, not every supported Node/RxJS/TS combination.

All 24 qualification-listed file hashes and all four report and metafile hashes match. The packed consumer result reports 106/106 passing, 0 skipped, with strict AOT and JSDOM harness, an external temporary consumer, unset NODE_PATH and no recorded workspace symlinks. Its 199 RxJS bundle input hashes match the independently retained installed RxJS 6.5.3 files; report paths are confined to the consumer. Its temporary consumer was removed, so the report and retained lock/input hashes are the surviving evidence, not an independently observed live install.

The four ChromeHeadless 149 historical reports identify the same actual tar SHA256 `08dae37e775e2ab50457d820b3c7ae98114059012125781378cd36f05d8990e5`: autocomplete 197/197, select 293/293, dialog 162/162, radio 100/100, total 752 including runner controls. All four metafiles contain 200 RxJS input paths confined to isolated `node_modules/rxjs`, no canonical workspace node_modules input, and the packed FESMs from target-run extracts. I compared all 512 archive members against each of five retained extractions: no mismatches. All nine executed candidate spec source images match both their receipt hashes and 53c0 Git bytes, and the producer preflight file hashes match that commit. The four autocomplete content-query lifecycle tests, including early open, input directive change, observation after opening before the query and destroy before query refresh, are individually recorded as passing.

The initial autocomplete attempt exited 1 before tests because its isolated historical test harness lacked `@angular/animations/browser`; the retained log shows that failure. The exact 22.1.7 animations package was then installed in that test fixture and the successful run is separately recorded. The isolated historical `build.mjs` delta adds `preserveSymlinks`, esbuild metadata collection and writes that metadata; it does not modify the artifact source guard. The historical fixture uses its separate installation, not the main workspace RxJS 7.8.2.

The 53c0→4066 change contains only six added select-five evidence JSON files, the changed audit ledger and the added select-five integration review. Exactly five existing SHA-keyed ledger entries changed; no product, selected test, runner or packed-consumer producer source changed. Exact eight afterimages are enumerated and hashed in `afterimages-v1.json` SHA256 `8d08afda67ac488410c5dfab257ac75f73424ab0a63b5a7725ae3fd06ee91275`. Product sources at the artifact's b6ef pack commit and 53c0 are also identical. This is a precise source transition, not proof of the separate ledger judgments.

The floor producer was run with `--tarball` and has no coordinator run ID; the four family reports are artifact-bound to the retained draft run, not the complete historical inventory. Six candidate spec-inventory hashes were stale before these runs. One arm64 Linux Chromium configuration and linked/installed fixture dependencies do not establish RxJS 7 floor, other Node or compiler combinations, x64, 21.x, G01–G13 or release qualification. No independent expensive replay was performed.
